question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** "collaboratively."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Collaboratively"** means working together with others to achieve a common goal. (एक तरह से जो एक साथ काम करने वाले दो या दो से अधिक दलों द्वारा निर्मित या शामिल होता है)

 
 
• **Example**: *The guidelines have been developed **collaboratively**__ between key agencies.*
 
 
 
• This word is appropriate in the context of the sentence, as it suggests that the task was accomplished through teamwork.
 
• Grammatically, the adverb **"collaboratively"** modifies the verb **"fill," **in
